programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Riders choose their risks to secure an advantage, all the time fully conscious that one mistake navigating the rocky trails means their race is over.
